dupr.source: supplied directly by DUPR on request, 2026-11-08

features.name: pd_doubles_mean
features.label: Doubles form
features.blurb: Average round reached in doubles brackets in the weeks before the draft, on a 1-7 ladder (Round of 32 = 1, Champion = 7). MLP is played as team doubles, so this is the most direct evidence bidders had.

features.name: pd_round_max
features.label: Best finish
features.blurb: Deepest run in any bracket before the draft, same 1-7 ladder. Catches the player who broke through once but is otherwise unremarkable.

features.name: pd_events
features.label: Brackets entered
features.blurb: How many brackets the player entered before draft day. Partly form, partly a measure of who was healthy and active on tour.

features.name: log_total_2025
features.label: 2025 earnings
features.blurb: Contracts plus prize money the season before the draft. Carried the model before form was available; now adds almost nothing on top of it.
